tasks.title: Establish the source IG contract
tasks.goal: Turn the current proposal into a small versioned source-record contract that preserves all required mechanical concepts without implementing rules.
outputs: contracts/ig/README.md with canonicalization and reference rules
Synthetic valid/invalid fixtures and validator entry point
inputs: Synthetic clauses, evidence, groups, gaps and review records
acceptance: Schema represents sources/regions, clauses with stable aspects and semantic groups, relations, gaps, origin bindings, coverage, profiles, runs, reviews and snapshots.
ID and revision hash rules are explicit and deterministic; anonymous identities do not depend on array position.
Source representation distinguishes review, coverage and executable readiness; source-level opaque is accepted without granting execution.
State, causal history, parameters, persistent choices, reactions, continuations, costs, geometry, tables, chance and visibility have addressable source representations; no generic payload-only claim.
No importer, formal interpreter, compiler or game logic is implemented; record open formal-language decisions for IG-3A.
tests: Use independent valid/invalid fixture cases for unknown value without gap, changed aspect, model approval, dangling active versus historical reference, duplicate identity and opaque execution blocker.
start_conditions: All dependencies are done; input revisions and assigned file scope are pinned.
Actual executor configuration and ownership are recorded; unresolved refinement prevents start.
exclusions: Archives and Git history; neighbouring repositories; global configuration.
Downstream tasks, unrelated changes, online services, commits and pushes.
Publisher content in public fixtures; automatic semantic acceptance.
blockers: A required contract is ambiguous, input changed, or owned files have another writer: checkpoint and escalate to coordinator.
After two unchanged retries or two repair cycles, record blocked with the smallest resolution needed.
handoff: Freeze deliverable paths/SHA-256, input packet hash, exact criteria met/unmet, test commands/exits and independent review request.
Record actual model/reasoning evidence, UTC/wall time, observed tokens or null, defects, unresolved decisions and next operation.
